A FEW THINGS YOU MIGHT WONDER

Good questions.

Where do you offer photo booth rentals?

Snapbooth serves events in New York and New Jersey. Send your venue location with your inquiry so we can confirm travel and availability.

Can I customize the photo frame?

Yes. After booking, we send a Canva template for your custom frame. Add your names, event date, colors or company logo, and we’ll help get it ready for printing.

Do guests get prints and digital photos?

Our VIP package includes unlimited prints and digital photos and GIFs available via QR code.

Is sending an inquiry a confirmed booking?

An inquiry lets us check availability and discuss your event. Your booking is confirmed separately once we finalize the details with you.

Do you stay during the event?

Yes, an on-site attendant helps guests use the booth. We also arrive early to set up.
